trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of what happened:
- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate. The deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the last healthy production release.
- **Rollback:** The first rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving a mixed state. I re-ran the rollback, which completed successfully — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy with a 0.002 error rate.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002** (on-call paged) describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0.
